parameters.content:
## GlobeXAI - Blockchain Escrow Workflow

Four independent webhook branches. No Postgres nodes, no n8n credentials required -
every write goes through the FastAPI escrow routes, which own the DB connection and RLS.
Import this file and activate it; nothing else to configure.

A - globex-escrow-create : create + fund escrow
B - globex-doc-anchor    : anchor a document hash
C - globex-shipment-event: set a condition, then release only if the contract's own
                           conditions are met (n8n never overrides the contract)
D - globex-dispute       : raise a dispute (never reaches any release node)

All HTTP nodes call http://host.docker.internal:8000/api/v1/... with neverError=true,
so a 4xx/5xx from FastAPI flows into a classifier Code node instead of killing the run.

nodes.name: Branch A Notes - Create + Fund Escrow

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ buyer_address: $('Code - Validate Branch A Input').item.json.buyer_address, seller_address: $('Code - Validate Branch A Input').item.json.seller_address, amount_usdc: $('Code - Validate Branch A Input').item.json.amount_usdc }) }}

nodes.name: Branch C Notes - Shipment Event to Release

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ kind: $('Code - Validate Branch C Input').item.json.kind, value: $('Code - Validate Branch C Input').item.json.value }) }}
